##### Project general facts

The Unexpected Al Marjan Island Hotel and Residence by Almal Real Estate Development brings a legendary hospitality brand, born on a Mediterranean party island and famous for music, luxury and irreverence, to the shores of the Arabian Gulf. The building rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to eight residential floors and a rooftop. Light-coloured materials create a clean, inviting look by day, while an illuminated archway and a roof canopy of backlit fabrics transform it at night.

Amenities are inspired by the brand's world-renowned entertainment experiences. Residents and guests enjoy a rooftop infinity pool with views over the sea, additional pools and a beach club with premium VIP amenities. A spa and wellness centre and a fitness area support relaxation and an active routine, while a two-level outdoor bar with an upper deck, meeting and events facilities and retail shops add vibrant social and everyday experiences throughout the day and night.

The collection offers studios and one- and two-bedroom hotel apartments, designed with contemporary elegance and breathtaking sea views. Interiors combine refined finishes with smart layouts, and generous windows frame the coastline and the island's resorts. Residences are delivered fully furnished and are operated under a hotel and residence concept, giving owners access to professional management, gourmet dining, VIP services and a lifestyle centred on music, wellness and entertainment.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a group of reclaimed coral-shaped islands off the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, known for its pristine beaches, turquoise waters and resort atmosphere. The Wynn Al Marjan Island integrated resort, the first of its kind in the UAE, sits right next door, alongside beach clubs, hotels, restaurants and a waterfront promenade for residents and visitors.

The Wynn resort is within walking distance, and Al Hamra Village with its golf course, marina and mall is a short drive away. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is easily reached, while Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Sharjah International Airport, Dubai and Dubai International Airport for business and leisure travel, while schools and clinics serve families on the mainland.

Al Marjan Island is a freehold destination open to international buyers, with full foreign ownership and no personal income tax. The arrival of the Wynn integrated resort is driving strong growth in tourism and short-term rental demand across the island. Fully furnished branded hotel apartments steps from the resort appeal to investors seeking rental income and buyers looking for a coastal second home.
